abilities.name: Ember Dart
abilities.effect: A narrow ember shot; preserves Homura's current bolt and armor exposure.

abilities.name: Root Circle
abilities.effect: Radial push and one-heart heal with a separate 360-update heal lock; preserves Midori.

abilities.name: Gust Fan
abilities.effect: Directional projectile clearing and wind-up interruption; preserves Fuuri.

abilities.name: Stone Guard
abilities.effect: A 36-update one-hit guard and short-range interrupt; preserves Kohaku.

abilities.name: Hearthline
abilities.effect: Trace three warm floor cells; after a 24-update warning they flare once. No lingering multi-hit stacking.

abilities.name: Canopy Knot
abilities.effect: Root a target in a small patch for 60 updates and shield the hero from one projectile; does not stack with Stone Guard.

abilities.name: Slipstream Loom
abilities.effect: Place a 48-update curved air lane; bends hostile shots sideways, without reflecting damage or changing collision.

abilities.name: Vaultstep
abilities.effect: Plant an arch-shaped shield for 48 updates; hold one additional hit, but forbid attacking during its 12-update root.

abilities.name: Dew Ring
abilities.effect: Lay a small water ring that slows ordinary enemy movement for 60 updates; bosses are not immobilized.

abilities.name: Tide Stitch
abilities.effect: Connect two marked pools for a single dash-back rescue; never crosses unmarked walls or story gates.

abilities.name: Chime Pin
abilities.effect: Send a returning tuning pin that cancels one telegraphed attack; misses have a long recovery.

abilities.name: Quiet Orbit
abilities.effect: Place three orbiting drops that cancel at most three projectiles over 120 updates; each saved drop becomes one counter-shot on expiry.

abilities.name: Threadhold
abilities.effect: A narrow Wood tether deals16 Q4 base damage and pulls one ordinary enemy at most8 swept pixels. Bosses cannot be pulled. Only tagged loads can be reeled in field puzzles.

abilities.name: Shuttle Span
abilities.effect: Set a short visible thread between two authored endpoints for at most60 updates;24 Q4 once per enemy per cast. Every segment and target must have line of sight.

abilities.name: Heat Pocket
abilities.effect: Place one visible stationary heat patch that bursts after18 updates for24 Q4 once per enemy; maximum lifetime48. Field heat charges affect only tagged receptacles.

abilities.name: Firing Drawer
abilities.effect: Move a stored heat patch between two short visible positions before its arrival burst,24 Q4 once per enemy. Maximum lifetime60; never crosses unmarked walls or ignites from phase alone.

abilities.name: Washback
abilities.effect: A short frontal surge deals24 Q4 and pushes ordinary enemies at most10 swept pixels. No boss displacement. Buoy only explicitly tagged dock loads.

abilities.name: Wake Turn
abilities.effect: A telegraphed L-shaped surge travels at most48 pixels across two orthogonal segments,24 Q4 once per enemy. Check walls on every segment and target; pivot only marked floating loads.

abilities.name: Counterdrop
abilities.effect: Place a visible small Earth impact that lands after18 updates for24 Q4 once per enemy. Press only authored counterweight pans; manual weights remain a mandatory-route alternative.

abilities.name: Counterpoise
abilities.effect: One placed weight intercepts one hostile projectile then emits a32 Q4 Earth pulse. Maximum lifetime48; no player invulnerability or healing; normal boss vulnerability still applies.

abilities.name: Quarterturn
abilities.effect: Redirect one approaching hostile projectile90 degrees into a visible side lane, making it friendly Metal without field or fire tags. Align only marked four-position rail junctions.

abilities.name: Gimbal Screen
abilities.effect: Place one directional gate for at most48 updates, turning up to two later hostile shots90 degrees. A per-cast projectile ledger forbids repeated redirection; friendly shots are ignored.

abilities.name: Leafbound
abilities.effect: Brief companion sidestep and narrow lateral Wood cut, 16 Q4 once per target. Swept collision; no player teleport or invulnerability.

abilities.name: Canopy Arc
abilities.effect: Previewed two-segment curved seed arc, 24 Q4 once per enemy. Bounded path and wall collision; not a stronger straight shot.

abilities.name: Ridgekick
abilities.effect: Short widening Earth wedge, 20 Q4 once per enemy, with bounded push of ordinary targets. No boss displacement.

abilities.name: Rampart Turn
abilities.effect: One short angled ridge redirects an ordinary walking enemy into a visible side lane, then crumbles for 20 Q4. No boss displacement or player-trapping collision; one ridge maximum.

abilities.name: Lens Dart
abilities.effect: Narrow Water bead splits into two outward rays only on its first target impact: initial 16 Q4, secondary 8 Q4. Initial target cannot be hit again; rays respect walls.

abilities.name: Prism Wake
abilities.effect: One short-lived visible line splits the next eligible ordinary hostile shot into two harmless outward droplets, then ends. Endpoint Water burst is 24 Q4; one line and one consumed shot, no recycling.

abilities.name: Ember Hush
abilities.effect: One visible warm mark lengthens an ordinary enemy's next attack windup, then pops for 16 Q4 Fire. Boss telegraphs are not retimed; one mark and finite expiry.

abilities.name: Bellows Ring
abilities.effect: Visible expanding Fire annulus with an empty safe center, 24 Q4 once per target at its edge. One bounded ring; respects obstacles.

abilities.name: Sideguard
abilities.effect: Brace a narrow flank for one ordinary melee hit and reply with a 16 Q4 Earth swipe. Front and rear remain exposed; no general invulnerability.

abilities.name: Vault Step
abilities.effect: Move a narrow guard to one of two explicitly selected side positions, producing a 24 Q4 lateral wave after interception. One eligible hit; visible vulnerable sides remain.

abilities.name: Pinch Window
abilities.effect: Catch one marked ordinary melee strike in a narrow frontal arc and reply with a 24 Q4 Metal pin. Clear startup, no instant universal parry; boss windows remain unchanged.

abilities.name: Shear Gate
abilities.effect: Place two visible facing blades for one short crossing window; crossing target receives 24 Q4 once. One gate maximum and bounded lifetime; existing boss vulnerability rules apply.

abilities.name: Sapling Feint
abilities.effect: One brief grounded decoy diverts one eligible ordinary enemy approach, then folds. No boss taunt, player teleport or invulnerability.

abilities.name: Canopy Exchange
abilities.effect: Two short-lived decoys with a visible connecting line redirect one eligible approach toward the safer endpoint. A 16 Q4 Wood snap only after activation; no teleport or invulnerability.

abilities.name: Rill Fork
abilities.effect: Short Y-shaped Water fork, 12 Q4 per branch with one hit cap per target and a small slowing effect. Bounded segments respect walls; no player pull.

abilities.name: Veil Curl
abilities.effect: Clearly drawn Water crescent with a gap catches side approaches for 24 Q4 once. Escape lane remains open, walls block the curl and the player is never pulled.

abilities.name: Warm Echo
abilities.effect: Mark one visible target for the next ordinary weapon hit, triggering one delayed 16 Q4 Fire follow-up. One mark and short expiry prevent stockpiling; no through-wall targeting.

abilities.name: Paired Echo
abilities.effect: Link two separately aimed target marks. Striking one triggers a weak follow-up on the other only with line of sight; total 24 Q4 budget, no chains, friendly fire or through-wall targeting.

abilities.name: Needle Bank
abilities.effect: One Metal spine with one wall ricochet and a visible reflection. Swept segments, 20 Q4 maximum once per target; no extra bounces.

abilities.name: Quill Return
abilities.effect: Three-spine fan retracts along the creature's current unobstructed lane. Outbound and return share a 24 Q4 per-target budget; at most three bounded objects and no through-wall return.

abilities.name: Warm Thread
abilities.effect: Draw a 40px ground thread after an 8-update warning; first crossing ends it. No through-wall segments.

abilities.name: Coil Clamp
abilities.effect: Two hooked arcs close on a 32px pocket; a target is hit once across both arcs. The player can walk through.

abilities.name: Crown Interval
abilities.effect: Show three short spokes, then activate them in order; share a 32Q4 target budget across the whole cast. Gap remains visibly safe.

abilities.name: Heel Knock
abilities.effect: A narrow 22px stomp cone interrupts eligible ordinary foes; no boss displacement or terrain mutation.

abilities.name: Brace Reply
abilities.effect: Visible frontal bracing arc catches one eligible ordinary contact attack, then replies; expiry gives no damage and no invulnerability.

abilities.name: Archfall
abilities.effect: A visible overhead arch lands in a wide 44px frontal crescent after its warning. No temporary solid wall, crush or player push.

abilities.name: Burr Skip
abilities.effect: One bouncing seed follows two 18px ground hops; first ordinary hit gets a short visible slow. Walls end the path.

abilities.name: Root Hem
abilities.effect: Two parallel 32px root lines leave a walkable central gap; crossing either gives one brief ordinary-root effect, never on a boss.

abilities.name: Cone Drop
abilities.effect: Aimed visible 12px landing marker within48px; one falling cone hits after16 updates, with line of sight checked at aim and impact.

abilities.name: Mist Stop
abilities.effect: A short square puff at28px arrests one eligible ordinary rush without pulling the player; one target hit per cast.

abilities.name: Cup Shower
abilities.effect: A stationary narrow three-drop column falls at a visible marker; all drops share24Q4 maximum per target.

abilities.name: Ribbon Sweep
abilities.effect: A45px lateral water band travels along one wall-checked segment; widens only after its first12px. Single target budget24Q4.

abilities.name: Pick Tap
abilities.effect: Two short alternating nail jabs; second occurs only if first misses, so one enemy cannot take both.

abilities.name: Spiral Notch
abilities.effect: A narrow28px corkscrew strike; deals ordinary Metal damage with bounded stagger on an already vulnerable target. No armor bypass.

abilities.name: Tail Pendulum
abilities.effect: A short visible diagonal swing releases one18px lateral shard; swing and shard share24Q4, walls stop both.

abilities.name: Cinder Tilt
abilities.effect: One26px diagonal dart from the chosen facing side, with a readable aiming blink; stops at first wall or enemy.

abilities.name: Plume Cut
abilities.effect: A narrow rising slash then a forward falling slash; shared24Q4 target cap, no auto-tracking after startup.

abilities.name: Ash Screen
abilities.effect: A stationary small screen consumes one ordinary hostile projectile, expires after40 updates, then makes a16Q4 outward puff. Boss beams unaffected.

abilities.name: Gravel Sift
abilities.effect: A short fan of three ground chips, sharing20Q4 per target; maximum travel30px and wall stops per chip.

abilities.name: Terrace Lift
abilities.effect: A sequence of two rising28px wedges separated by a safe lateral gap; one hit per target across both, no forced boss movement.

abilities.name: Sprig March
abilities.effect: One slow ground bud advances36px with a visible toe-like motion; it ends on first enemy or wall rather than lingering.

abilities.name: Trellis Bend
abilities.effect: Two connected ground segments form one chosen L-shaped path, capped48px total; one hit per target and no wall penetration.

abilities.name: Bead Step
abilities.effect: Three small outward beads leave large gaps; one enemy can receive only16Q4 across the fan. No homing.

abilities.name: Dewfold
abilities.effect: An expanding five-lobed ring shows safe gaps before moving; edge-only24Q4 once per target, never a full-screen burst.

forms.name: Homura
forms.silhouette: Compact fox with one curled wick tail and a low forward body line; keep the existing original sprite.
forms.motion: Quick two-step scurry; tail settles a beat later.

forms.name: Homura Hearthkeeper
forms.silhouette: Longer low fox with a broad ceramic hearth mantle and three ash fins, retaining its single tail; never add multiple tails.
forms.motion: Plants the mantle before tracing a deliberate floor line.

forms.name: Midori
forms.silhouette: The existing hovering leaf spirit, with its broad leaf body and visible seed core.
forms.motion: Soft side-to-side float with an asymmetric leaf fold.

forms.name: Midori Canopykeeper
forms.silhouette: An inverted umbrella of three leaves with a suspended seed and visible braided root hem.
forms.motion: Opens the canopy, then anchors roots before a shield appears.

forms.name: Fuuri
forms.silhouette: Keep the cream moth-spirit, lavender feather-like wings and split ribbon tail already in the campaign.
forms.motion: Unequal wingbeats create a visible gust; ribbon follows the turn.

forms.name: Fuuri Windweaver
forms.silhouette: A spindle-bodied silk moth with four narrow sail panels and a woven open loop trailing below.
forms.motion: Tilts the panels in sequence to draw curved air paths.

forms.name: Kohaku
forms.silhouette: Keep the three segmented amber plates, two moss sprouts and tiny feet; it is not a turtle.
forms.motion: Short deliberate steps; the three plates compress during guard.

forms.name: Kohaku Archwarden
forms.silhouette: Four pillar feet carry an open amber arch with a hollow center and moss lintel, not a larger solid shell.
forms.motion: Pillars spread and the arch locks; rocks chime once on impact.
forms.role: Stationary two-hit defense with a mobility cost

forms.name: Dewspindle
forms.silhouette: A translucent spiral droplet suspended from two reed-like legs, with no fish or amphibian outline.
forms.motion: Alternating stilt steps draw tiny circular ripples.

forms.name: Tidewheel
forms.silhouette: A vertical ring of water turns around a hollow reed axle; two spoon-shaped feet skim pools.
forms.motion: Wheel rotates while feet stay level, then unwinds into a linking strand.

forms.name: Chimeclasp
forms.silhouette: A spring-jawed bronze clasp on three unequal prongs, with one suspended tuning tongue.
forms.motion: Coils, releases a tuning pin, then catches it with an audible clasp.

forms.name: Spoolbud
forms.silhouette: A low living thicket with a bobbin-shaped seed body, expressive knot face, leaf ears, four root paws and a vine-loop tail.
forms.motion: Sniffs the rope end, gathers its paws, then rocks forward with a breathing seed body.

forms.name: Loomcrown
forms.silhouette: A tall long-legged thicket animal; arched shoulder branches frame an open trellis above its living face and chest.
forms.motion: Leans into a two-point tether, ears focused; the vine tail slips through the open shoulder crown.

forms.name: Cindertray
forms.silhouette: A squat warm ceramic quadruped with rounded muzzle, amber eyes, handle-like ears, cheek vents and a triangular back plate.
forms.motion: Pads toward warmth, crouches to breathe out heat, then raises its soft-looking ceramic ears.

forms.name: Kilnbarrow
forms.silhouette: A low elongated ceramic animal with broad forelegs, an expressive head and two kiln-like shoulder plates that open sideways.
forms.motion: Lopes deliberately, carries a glowing heat drawer, and settles its side plates with a relieved exhale.

forms.name: Tangleaper
forms.silhouette: Wide-toed gecko with lifted eyes, short rounded muzzle and one long coiled vine tail.
forms.motion: Alternating splayed-foot scuttle; watches its landing, coils, sidesteps and settles.

forms.name: Boughvault
forms.silhouette: Lean living gecko with connected leaf-like side membranes making a triangular gliding outline.
forms.motion: Crouches with aimed eyes, hops through a banking arc, then folds its continuous membranes.

forms.name: Duneroll
forms.silhouette: Big-eared dune mammal with long hind feet, compact forepaws and a thin tufted tail.
forms.motion: Ears tilt toward the slope; compresses its hind legs, kicks and lands in a short hop.
forms.role: Short widening wedge and bounded push

forms.name: Dunescoop
forms.silhouette: Long low dune mammal weighted onto two broad digging forefeet beneath a raised ear arc.
forms.motion: Low scoop-bound rhythm; plants its forefeet, turns its shoulders and lifts its muzzle.

forms.name: Coalcoil
forms.silhouette: A low snail with a broad smiling muzzle, two blunt eyestalks and a sideways crescent shell; pale foot clearly separate from charcoal shell.
forms.motion: Foot ripples in four readable waves; shell rocks after the head stops.

forms.name: Emberhelix
forms.silhouette: A raised snail on a narrow long foot; its open spiral shell sits upright with a large triangular window and expressive face below.
forms.motion: Stretch, brace, pull the shell forward; spiral tips lag by one pose.

forms.name: Hearthcrown
forms.silhouette: A long muscular snail with a flat fan-shaped shell held above its face on three connected shell ribs; large open spaces replace the earlier spiral.
forms.motion: Wide foot fans to anchor, then contracts into an unhurried glide.

forms.name: Shardibex
forms.silhouette: A small round-nosed mountain goat with short straight stone horns, wide cloven feet and a tilted rectangular shoulder patch.
forms.motion: Quick paired hoof plants, head dip, rear-foot catch-up.

forms.name: Bracehorn
forms.silhouette: A low broad-shouldered goat with huge outward U-curved horns enclosing its face, short hindquarters and distinctly spread forehooves.
forms.motion: Three-beat brace and short forward shuffle; head stays level.

forms.name: Spanram
forms.silhouette: A tall long-legged ram with two high buttress horns joining above its brow, a narrow waist and two strong negative-space arches.
forms.motion: High deliberate diagonal hoof steps; horns sway opposite hips.

forms.name: Tuftpika
forms.silhouette: A tiny pika with long swept-back grass whiskers, round ears, a square leafy tail tuft and two high-set dark eyes.
forms.motion: Compact four-paw gallop, pause, whisker flick.

forms.name: Rootmuffle
forms.silhouette: A low long-bodied pika with a broad root beard and two separated leafy shoulder mounds; its ears and living muzzle remain exposed.
forms.motion: Low belly-clear scamper; beard trails, then gathers beneath chin.

forms.name: Sporevault
forms.silhouette: An upright long-hindleg pika with a closed pinecone tail carried above its head and a tiny chest between large open arm spaces.
forms.motion: Crouch, tall hop, two-foot settle; tail opens only during casting.

forms.name: Chalklung
forms.silhouette: A living porous sponge with three soft lobed feet, one angled chimney and a friendly face on its lower flexible skirt.
forms.motion: Three-foot rocking walk; chimney compresses and rebounds as it breathes.

forms.name: Bellcup
forms.silhouette: A tall sponge with an inverted bell mouth, a long curved neck, broad two-lobed base and a face looking out beneath the rim.
forms.motion: Leans forward on the base, straightens neck, then draws the base underneath.

forms.name: Runnelribbon
forms.silhouette: A flat ribbon sponge with two raised breathing sails, four stub feet and a living face at one blunt leading corner.
forms.motion: Sideways inchworm fold, unfold and soft skirt sweep.

forms.name: Orelet
forms.silhouette: A round mole with a pale snout, narrow metallic digging nails and one smooth ore nodule at the tip of its very short tail.
forms.motion: Alternating outward forepaw scoops with its feet visibly above the ground.

forms.name: Augermole
forms.silhouette: A long wedge-bodied mole whose broad serrated forepaws frame a low face; its body tapers into a small straight tail.
forms.motion: Wide shoulder crawl with nails swept behind during recovery.

forms.name: Pendulumole
forms.silhouette: An upright mole with long forearms, broad planted hindfeet and an elongated heavy tail curved into a counterweight loop.
forms.motion: Two hindfoot steps then tail counter-swing; face aims independently of arms.

forms.name: Ashkite
forms.silhouette: A planthopper with a broad kite-shaped shell, very short antennae, tucked legs and a visible round face below a shallow hood.
forms.motion: Tiny spring hop, side slip and four-foot landing.

forms.name: Plumehopper
forms.silhouette: A tall long-legged hopper with a narrow upright plume, a pear-shaped abdomen and an open diamond between its rear legs.
forms.motion: High tucked-leg spring, upright hover beat and heel-first landing.

forms.name: Huskdrifter
forms.silhouette: A broad leaf-shaped hopper held horizontally beneath translucent folded shell sails, with a small face extending beyond their front edge.
forms.motion: Low skirt-like glide with visible occasional leg taps; not a permanent flight permission.

forms.name: Keelkip
forms.silhouette: A seal-like companion with round muzzle, bright eyes, broad front flippers, forked hind flipper and three overlapping translucent body plates.
forms.motion: Lifts its chest into a flipper-waddle, then settles into a buoyant sliding turn.

forms.name: Wakecradle
forms.silhouette: A broad seal-like animal with long outward-curving flippers and a raised back crest framing a suspended water sling beneath its continuous body.
forms.motion: Banks on one flipper, swings the water sling around a visible corner and lands with a curious head tilt.

forms.name: Cairncricket
forms.silhouette: A cricket-like animal with three offset stone plates, bright eyes beneath a pebble brow, flexible antennae, short forefeet and long jointed hind legs.
forms.motion: Crouches, springs and lands with antenna recoil; the upper stone plate tilts like a living brow.

forms.name: Archspring
forms.silhouette: A high-arched stone cricket with paired long hind legs, a hanging tail stone and large negative spaces between its expressive body and legs.
forms.motion: Leans its face into a deliberate springing gait, then settles a protective counterweight ahead.

forms.name: Rivetfoil
forms.silhouette: A small folded bird with fan-shaped metal wings, a bright eye, pointed beak, forked feet, short balancing tail and one off-center rivet mark.
forms.motion: Tilts its head, side-steps, and flicks one wing to turn an approaching shot into a visible side lane.

forms.name: Gimbalcloak
forms.silhouette: A crested long-necked metal bird whose broad cloak wings surround a gimbal-shaped breast; its face stays visible above the mechanism.
forms.motion: Steps sideways, spreads a directional wing screen, then tucks its wings with a living recovery pose.

forms.name: Skimkip
forms.silhouette: Flying-fish-like animal with cheek spots, short beakless mouth, broad paired fins and forked tail.
forms.motion: Skims low, plants its fins, aims its cheek-lit face and snaps its tail before the cast.

forms.name: Sailskip
forms.silhouette: Long-bodied fish animal with tall connected sail fins framing a strong V-shaped negative space.
forms.motion: Banks through a longer arc; lifts its sail fins, breathes and folds them into a low landing.
forms.role: Single-shot splitting line with endpoint burst

forms.name: Warmcroak
forms.silhouette: Squat round frog with heavy eyelids, short webbed feet and one pale warm throat pouch.
forms.motion: Blinks slowly, takes a deliberate hop and swells its throat before a soft exhale.

forms.name: Bellowswell
forms.silhouette: Broad-stance frog with paired connected cheek and throat folds below an expressive heavy-lidded head.
forms.motion: Rears above wide hind feet, opens its folds for a two-beat exhale, then settles and blinks.

forms.name: Shellwaddle
forms.silhouette: Sideways sand crab with two unequal soft-tipped claws, tracking stalk eyes and a low shell arch.
forms.motion: Eyes follow the player as it sidles; braces one flank, swipes and releases its stance.

forms.name: Vaultback
forms.silhouette: Long-legged crab with a high open shell vault above a visible abdomen and broad under-body gap.
forms.motion: Broad sideways strut; chooses a side, raises the rear legs, intercepts and lowers the vault.

forms.name: Clipmantis
forms.silhouette: Upright thin mantis with triangular expressive head, large aimed eyes, long forearms and four fine walking legs.
forms.motion: Measures a short stalk, aims both eyes, opens its forearms and closes a clear startup arc.

forms.name: Foilscythe
forms.silhouette: Tall mantis with broad crescent forearm foils, long folded abdomen and subordinate close-held wings.
forms.motion: Measured high-knee stalk; unfolds facing foils, watches the crossing and closes them slowly.

forms.name: Swaylemur
forms.silhouette: Long-tailed tree mammal with round forward eyes, plain large ears, small hands and two leaf-like tail tufts.
forms.motion: Sways its tail while watching a route; plants a small decoy, leans aside and gathers its hands.

forms.name: Canopetail
forms.silhouette: Tall long-forearmed tree mammal suspended below a raised tail loop with broad separated leaf tufts.
forms.motion: Counterbalanced steps; reaches toward two endpoints, raises its tail loop and recoils after activation.

forms.name: Rillnewt
forms.silhouette: Low newt with a broad smiling mouth, four widely planted toes and a long flat tail.
forms.motion: Swaying knuckle crawl; lifts its smiling face, splays toes and sweeps a small fork with its tail.

forms.name: Veilcrest
forms.silhouette: Lifted-elbow newt with a transparent continuous dorsal veil and broad foreleg frills.
forms.motion: Raises its elbows and veil; turns its head through a crescent, then lowers the frills.

forms.name: Glimmerbat
forms.silhouette: Fruit-bat-like mammal with large ears, short bright muzzle, connected wing fingers and tucked tail.
forms.motion: Quick flap-hang pauses; ears aim at a target, muzzle brightens and wings fold after marking.

forms.name: Flarefan
forms.silhouette: Broad-winged bat with fingers fanning into a shallow W silhouette above long landing toes.
forms.motion: Lands on long hind toes, fans linked wing fingers toward two marks and slowly folds its wings.

forms.name: Needletrot
forms.silhouette: Long-snouted tenrec-like mammal with focused small eyes, rounded ears, short legs and low quill crest.
forms.motion: Quick nosing trot; aims its snout, banks one spine and shakes the crest into place.

forms.name: Quillstride
forms.silhouette: Slim living quilled mammal with long rear legs and an open fan of separately readable metallic spines.
forms.motion: Rises onto its rear legs, pivots an open quill fan, recalls it and settles its changed center of gravity.

forms.name: Screepeek
forms.silhouette: A stocky tapir with a short mobile trunk, small round ears, heavy hindquarters and three pale pebble pads along its shoulder.
forms.motion: Slow alternating four-foot stroll; trunk probes ahead on the idle beat.

forms.name: Stairtrunk
forms.silhouette: A long-trunked tapir with stepped flaring ears, high shoulders and low hindquarters, leaving a clear diagonal back silhouette.
forms.motion: Forefoot reach, trunk curl, broad rear step; ears fold on recovery.

forms.name: Mossmarch
forms.silhouette: A short six-legged caterpillar-like animal with a square muzzle, four separated moss cushions and a bare expressive brow.
forms.motion: Six legs ripple in three pairs while cushions squash in sequence.

forms.name: Trellislong
forms.silhouette: A long high-arched six-legged crawler with an open lattice of connected moss ribs above its smooth living underside and wide face.
forms.motion: Three alternating leg pairs carry a traveling body arch, never a static stretched base sprite.

forms.name: Dripurchin
forms.silhouette: A low sea-urchin-like animal with a soft visible face, five blunt movable spines and three rounded tube feet.
forms.motion: Rotates its feet without rotating its face, then bobs with gathered droplets.

forms.name: Dewmedusa
forms.silhouette: A tall soft-bodied urchin with its five spines opened into curved umbrella ribs and long joined tube-foot tassels; face hangs below the cap.
forms.motion: Gentle pulse-lift then trailing-foot settle; a grounded shadow makes its location legible.

forms.name: Stilltide Orrery
forms.silhouette: Three independent water arcs revolve around a small dark pebble, with a clear central void and no animal head.
forms.motion: Each arc slows separately when absorbing a shot, then realigns into a quiet orbit.
forms.role: Legendary projectile defense and delayed counterplay

trials.description: Balance unequal loads while preserving the reachable exit and reset handle.
Route the marked carriage through three bearings and prove its return path.
Carry bounded heat to all three visible chart-drying stations.
Float, pivot and unload the marked tender cargo using freely resettable safe stops.
Reconnect the paired marked pools in the reed-basin side quest.
Press three marked braces while each pedestrian side lane remains open; dragging a baffle into a walking lane invalidates only that attempt.
Draw two counterweights to opposite marked rests until the hanging clapper clears both sides; the player can inspect its entire swing.
Uncap three signposted spring mouths in separate pockets after observing their distinct bubbles; one dry inspection socket must be left closed.
Reveal the feeding current, fill the catch bowl and close two leaks before draining the practice outlet; targets have distinct shapes.
Turn three hood vanes to lift a visible ribbon through upper outlets without blowing on the seedling bed.
As form32, reuse one charged brick to dry clay, temper a tool and warm seedlings in that order, cooling it at a marked sink between uses; prove all three different outputs.
Grow two elevated seed supports after manually opening the airflow hood; carry the marked seed tray by the open upper walkway.
Turn the hood down into a settling basket, open its safe side bypass and return the hood to still; visible ash clears rather than becoming a damage cloud.
Reveal both branch arrows and fill alternating receiving bowls without feeding the already-full trough; no timer or random rain.
Grow roots into two dry hedge ties while a third living opening stays clear; choose the low sheltered plot, not every green target.
Reel the drying line through three marked hooks from different safe approaches while a wide worker passage remains unobstructed.
Tune three mechanically distinct catches after placing sound baffles on their pictogram rests; the source is geometry and vibration cues, not hearing acuity.
As form35, brace the high and low supports from opposite landings and move the central slab between them without blocking the marked return loop.
Store heat from each of three numbered refractory jars, then park each at the matching safe shelf; never warm the seedling tray.
Draw three sample pins out in the diagrammed direction while the protected pot is behind its baffle; each pin has an independent identity.
Complete the fixed three-vane no-projectile-hit wind-loom challenge after Sky clear; retries cost nothing.
Brace the two restoration pillars in one timed trial after Core clear; retries cost nothing.
Restore three distinct damaged root beds; repeated healing never counts.
Light three distinct abandoned hearths once each, then choose to nurture Homura at the sanctuary.
Reopen the visible three-part canopy shade route from opposite ends without obscuring the caretaker's exit.
Route one beam through three labeled demonstration receivers across two freely resettable configurations.
Trace three drawn drainage branches and clear marked caps before the visible overflow shortcut; RESET safely drains incorrect settings.
Release three paired catches without closing the worker's access lane; reset handles remain outside every catch.
Restore three separately drawn root supports from different reachable ledges in rooms 31 and 32.
